set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Human ceiling; docs/plans/2026-09-03-within-scene-precision-preregistration.md.

The within-scene machine lane scored 66.1% against a 25.0% midpoint null but is diagnostic only; the human lane has zero comparisons and no answers file exists.

Scope:
Run the preregistered human lane; this needs one person for about 90 minutes, not the second-coding team.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The answering person is recorded by role; the packet used matches the preregistered packet's hash.
2. The answers file lives in the ignored data root; its hash is committed.
3. The lane is scored with the preregistered scorer and the result is recorded in the ledger.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: S.
set.title: Phase 1b: the within-scene human lane (about 90 minutes of one person's answers)
